subject: Brightline retainer proposal — scope, phased SOW and PO requirements
messages:
From: Sofia Vega <sofia@brightlinecomms.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Cc: contracts@brightlinecomms.com
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Proposal: Q2-Q4 PR + Event support (retainer)

Hi Dylan —

Great speaking with you this morning. As promised, attached is our proposal for a Q2–Q4 retainer to support Redwood’s product launch cadence, ongoing PR, media outreach, and two regional events. Highlights:  

- Monthly retainer: $48,000 (includes media relations, asset prep, executive media coaching, and up to 12 press outreaches/month)
- Event support: separate SOW for events production (estimate $35k–$50k per event depending on scope)
- 30-day termination with 30-day wind-down

We’ve attached an initial SOW and a sample campaign calendar. If you want, we can split the retainer into a phased SOW (launch-focused + ongoing coverage) to make the upfront budget smaller.

Link to sign: https://www.docusign.com/sign/Brightline-Redwood-SOW
Attachments: Brightline_Proposal_2026-02.pdf, SOW_Brightline_v1.docx

Thanks — looking forward to the next steps.

Best,
Sofia Vega
Account Director | Brightline Communications
sofia@brightlinecomms.com
+1 415-555-0183
From: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
To: Sofia Vega <sofia@brightlinecomms.com>
Cc: aisha_rahman@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal: Q2-Q4 PR + Event support (retainer)

Sofia —

Thanks for sending this over. A few quick reactions from Marketing:  

- We like the proposed deliverables but need to bring the monthly retainer closer to $35k to fit the Q2 budget. Can you provide a phased SOW option that front-loads launch work (month 1–2) and reduces ongoing months?
- Could you break out the media list and expected KPIs (monthly mentions, top-tier placement targets) in the SOW?
- Events: we’ll likely run one west-coast launch (June) and one EMEA partner event in September. For contracting, we prefer event work to be separate, PO-driven scopes.

Looping in Laura for event budget and Aisha for final scope approval.

Next step: can Brightline send a revised SOW by next Wed (3/4)?

Cheers,
Dylan Brooks
Sr. Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 08:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal: Q2-Q4 PR + Event support (retainer)

Hi Dylan —

Thanks — attaching SOW_Brightline_v2.docx that splits the work into:  

1) Launch phase (months 1–2): higher touch — $60k one-time for launch activity (media blitz, executive coaching, press tour coordination).
2) Ongoing retainer (months 3–9): $34k/mo for steady-state media and coverage.

We also included a KPI appendix (expected placements, share of voice goals) and a separate events addendum (estimates only). We can confirm IIS and top-tier target lists once we get your product roadmap dates.

Attachments: SOW_Brightline_v2.docx, Brightline_KPI_appendix.pdf

If that looks reasonable I can send an updated DocuSign bundle for the phased SOW + standard T&Cs.

Best,
Sofia

Team —

I reviewed SOW_Brightline_v2. A couple of legal asks before we route to procurement:  

- Please remove the unilateral indemnity clause on page 5; propose mutual indemnity language.
- Data handling: need confirmation they won’t retain Redwood customer lists post-engagement; suggest a deletion clause and a brief data processing addendum.
- Payment terms: 30 days is fine, but add milestone invoicing for the launch phase (invoice at kickoff and at completion of month 2).

I’ve annotated key redlines in Redlines_Redwood_legal.pdf. If Brightline agrees, we can sign the phased SOW.

-David
